notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Juniper Order Druid.
description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
